Roadmap S2 wave 4 in tools/scope-commands.mjs (sole writer), modules already on main with no callers. Do NOT edit tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, tools/tickets.mjs, tools/ticket-sync-checks.mjs, tools/acceptance-provable.mjs, tools/sensitive-ticket.mjs or tools/manager-commands.mjs (read them; if one has a real gap, describe it in your final notes). Never write token-shaped literals. Tests: node:test, temp git repos, injected deps and fixed clock (no wall clock, env, TTY).
(T-0044, R-009) scope split --ingest: use tools/acceptance-provable.mjs (pathsInAcceptanceText, allowedPathsForAcceptance, ownersOfPath, provabilityOfAcceptanceLine, filterProvableAcceptance) so ingest REFUSES a build ticket whose acceptance names files it does not write or own (message: '<id>: acceptance line N names <path>, owned by <owner or nobody>'), and copied requirement acceptance lines skip route-level checks until the integration ticket exists (mark them deferred rather than refusing). Test file tests/scope-ingest-acceptance.test.mjs.
(T-0046, R-010) scope split --ingest: set ticket.sensitive with isSensitiveTicket(ticket, scope, reqLookup) from tools/sensitive-ticket.mjs instead of the scope-phrase match: a store-wrapper ticket that does not touch auth/customer data stays sensitive:false; a ticket writing a public API route (e.g. app/api/x/route.ts or src/routes/public/*) is sensitive:true. Owner overrides already on a ticket (risk/sensitive set by the owner) are kept. Test tests/scope-ingest-sensitive.test.mjs.
(T-0055, R-014) scope sync --integrated: run syncCheckForTicket (tools/ticket-sync-checks.mjs) per ticket: a delete-only ticket is marked done when its declared deletes are absent (with a tickets.log transition note 'delete-only: files gone'); a rename ticket is refused (stays in review/blocked with the problem text) until the old path is gone and the new path exists; migration tickets keep the DDL-only rule. Tests tests/scope-sync-delete.test.mjs and (T-0062) tests/ticket-delete-rename-regression.test.mjs (delete-only passes once files are gone, fails while one remains; rename ok vs both-present vs neither; migration DDL vs DML).
(Package E, roadmap T-0208 context) scope approve runs the ticket-manager scope gate: call runManagersScopeGate(root, { now }) from tools/manager-commands.mjs before writing the approval; if it returns a blocking result (read its return shape) refuse approval with its reason; a gate error is reported as a warning and does not block (log it). Injectable via deps for tests (tests/scope-approve-managers.test.mjs: blocking gate refuses; passing gate approves; throwing gate warns and approves).
(Nit) scope approve byte-budget warning: a ticket with no lane is measured against the first lane auto-routing would use (CHEAP_LANE_ORDER[0], an in-place lane with no byte cap), not Hermes; keep the warning for tickets whose lane is set to a capped lane. Update tests/scope-split-lane-size.test.mjs for this.
Keep these green: tests/scope-commands.test.mjs, tests/scope-ingest-paths.test.mjs, tests/scope-ingest-waves.test.mjs, tests/scope-sync-replan.test.mjs, tests/scope-split-lane-size.test.mjs, tests/batch-a-eval.test.mjs, tests/lesson-40-eval.test.mjs, tests/dogfood-fixes.test.mjs, tests/lesson-38-eval.test.mjs, tests/lessons-28-32-eval.test.mjs, tests/scope-delete-tickets.test.mjs, tests/lesson-39-integrate.test.mjs, tests/acceptance-provable.test.mjs, tests/sensitive-ticket.test.mjs. Run them plus the new tests with `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test ...` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
